exposure: ratio of muscle thickness on the affected side to that on the unaffected side (A/N ratio)
range of motion for cervical rotation and side bending
cohort: The study included 118 patients (79 males and 39 females) diagnosed with congenital muscular torticollis (CMT) who received physical therapy.
finding: Patients with a thicker SCM muscle, higher A/N ratio, lower birth weight, and a history of breech delivery required a longer rehabilitation duration.
mod_finding: The methods of delivery were not correlated with the rehabilitation duration.
birth_weight: Lower birth weight was negatively correlated with rehabilitation duration.
gest_age: Gestational age was measured but not correlated with rehabilitation duration.
